# Kluzar Tech Tools

> Kluzar Tech Tools is a free collection of browser-based developer, security and recon, webhook, SEO, design, and everyday utilities at https://tech.kluzar.com/.

Use the homepage to browse or search tools. Most text, formatting, conversion, and file tools process data in the browser. Network inspection tools send the target URL or domain to Kluzar's API at tech-api.kluzar.com to retrieve public network or page information. Their results are informational and are not a substitute for a complete security, compliance, or SEO audit.

No account is required. Use network and security tools only for systems you own or are authorized to assess. Webhook Capture creates a public endpoint: anyone who knows its URL can send requests, and captured request data is retained for up to 60 minutes. Do not send credentials, personal data, or other sensitive information to a capture endpoint.

## Site

- [Kluzar Tech Tools](https://tech.kluzar.com/): Browse and client-side search across the tool collection.

## Developer Tools

- [JSON Formatter](https://tech.kluzar.com/json-formatter/): Format, minify, validate, and sort JSON locally.
- [JavaScript Studio](https://tech.kluzar.com/js-formatter/): Beautify and minify JavaScript in the browser.
- [XML Formatter](https://tech.kluzar.com/xml-formatter/): Format, minify, and validate XML.
- [cURL Converter](https://tech.kluzar.com/curl-converter/): Convert common cURL requests into JavaScript, Node.js, Python, or PHP snippets.
- [JSON and CSV Converter](https://tech.kluzar.com/json-csv/): Convert between tabular JSON and CSV.
- [Code Diff Checker](https://tech.kluzar.com/code-diff/): Compare text or code line by line.
- [Regex Tester](https://tech.kluzar.com/regex-tester/): Test JavaScript regular expressions against text.
- [Markdown Preview](https://tech.kluzar.com/markdown-preview/): Preview sanitized Markdown locally.
- [Base64 Tool](https://tech.kluzar.com/base64-tool/): Encode and decode Base64 text.
- [URL Encoder and Decoder](https://tech.kluzar.com/url-tool/): Encode or decode URL components and inspect query parameters.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://tech.kluzar.com/unix-time/): Convert Unix timestamps and local date-time values.
- [UUID and ULID Generator](https://tech.kluzar.com/uuid-generator/): Generate UUID v4 and ULID identifiers.
- [CHMOD Calculator](https://tech.kluzar.com/chmod-calculator/): Convert Unix permissions to numeric and symbolic modes.
- [Cron Builder](https://tech.kluzar.com/cron-builder/): Build five-field cron schedules and preview upcoming runs.

## Security and Reconnaissance

- [JWT Studio](https://tech.kluzar.com/jwt-decoder/): Decode JWTs and work with HMAC signatures locally; token decoding alone does not validate trust or claims.
- [CORS and Headers Inspector](https://tech.kluzar.com/cors-checker/): Inspect public response headers and CORS-related headers for a target URL.
- [Hash Generator](https://tech.kluzar.com/hash-generator/): Calculate SHA-family hashes in the browser.
- [JavaScript Recon Scanner](https://tech.kluzar.com/js-scanner/): Search pasted JavaScript for domains, paths, token-like strings, and source-map references.
- [Old URL Extractor](https://tech.kluzar.com/oldurls/): Extract URLs and paths from pasted code, logs, or text.
- [Recon Data Parser](https://tech.kluzar.com/recon-parser/): Extract and deduplicate hostnames from pasted reconnaissance output.
- [DNS Lookup](https://tech.kluzar.com/dns-lookup/): Query public DNS record types for a domain.
- [Subdomain Finder](https://tech.kluzar.com/subdomain-finder/): Find hostnames in public certificate-transparency records.
- [URL Scanner](https://tech.kluzar.com/url-scanner/): Inspect a public URL's response status and selected security headers.
- [SEO Analyzer](https://tech.kluzar.com/seo-analyzer/): Fetch and inspect a public page's title, metadata, headings, and language.
- [File Inspector](https://tech.kluzar.com/file-inspector/): Inspect local file metadata, magic bytes, and sample entropy; this is not a malware scanner.
- [Security Report Builder](https://tech.kluzar.com/security-report/): Draft a structured security or bug-bounty finding report.

## Webhooks and API

- [Webhook Capture](https://tech.kluzar.com/webhook-capture/): Create a temporary public endpoint and inspect incoming HTTP requests.
- [HTTP Workbench](https://tech.kluzar.com/http-workbench/): Send an HTTP request through Kluzar's API and inspect its response.
- [System Health](https://tech.kluzar.com/system-health/): Check the availability of Kluzar's network API.

## Design, Media, and Content

- [Logo Generator](https://tech.kluzar.com/logo-generator/): Create and download a simple branded logo graphic.
- [CSS Style Generator](https://tech.kluzar.com/css-generator/): Generate glass and soft-shadow CSS with a live preview.
- [Color Converter](https://tech.kluzar.com/color-converter/): Convert HEX colors to RGB and HSL and generate palette shades.
- [Color Contrast Checker](https://tech.kluzar.com/color-contrast/): Check selected text and background colors against WCAG AA contrast thresholds.
- [Image Converter](https://tech.kluzar.com/image-converter/): Convert supported image formats in the browser.
- [Image Compressor](https://tech.kluzar.com/image-compressor/): Resize and compress local images with format and quality controls.
- [QR Code Generator](https://tech.kluzar.com/qr-generator/): Generate downloadable QR codes from text and other input.
- [PDF Merger](https://tech.kluzar.com/pdf-merger/): Merge PDF files locally in the browser.
- [Text Analyzer](https://tech.kluzar.com/text-analyzer/): Count words and characters, estimate reading time, and inspect frequent words.
- [Text Transformer](https://tech.kluzar.com/text-transformer/): Convert text case and create common identifier formats.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://tech.kluzar.com/lorem-generator/): Generate placeholder copy for layouts and mockups.
- [Robots.txt Builder](https://tech.kluzar.com/robots-builder/): Create robots.txt rules and a sitemap directive.
- [XML Sitemap Builder](https://tech.kluzar.com/sitemap-builder/): Generate an XML sitemap from a list of URLs.
- [Password Generator](https://tech.kluzar.com/password-generator/): Generate random passwords locally with selectable character sets.
